article.title: A Smartphone-Based Ecological Momentary Intervention for Workplace Mental Health: Randomized Controlled Trial.
article.authors: Li S, Lo LHL, Lau CYC
article.abstract: Work-related stress has been widely associated with an increased risk of various mental disorders and poor mental well-being. The fast-growing mobile health services industry has provided new opportunities for workplace mental health.
